sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # edge-io-measurement-node Ring / Edge I/O **sensing and measurement** stack for gunnchOS3k — privacy-first telemetry, firmware paths, and Lab-facing contracts. > **Current release/state:** `PHYSICAL_PENDING` — digital pipelines + synthetic smoke exist; absolute spatial accuracy on hardware is pending. Ecosystem portal: [gunnchos-research-portal](https://github.com/gunnchOS3k/gunnchos-research-portal) · Product chart

sections.title: What is this?
sections.body: Schemas, probes, firmware/research paths, and opt-in telemetry for Edge I/O Rings and related measurement nodes.

sections.title: Why does it exist?
sections.body: Embodied input and honest network/experience metrics need a dedicated measurement layer with consent and claim discipline.

sections.title: Where does it fit?
sections.body: Product Charter **layer 7** (Ring sensing/measurement). Consumed by `gunnchos-device-os` Ring/input paths.

sections.title: What is real today?
sections.body: - Schema-validated synthetic / smoke telemetry (`make smoke` / `make e2e`) - Privacy helpers and 7GC/Lab export contracts - Firmware and gate1 digital fabrication *research* artifacts as documented in-tree

sections.title: What is simulated / modelled?
sections.body: - Synthetic measurement batches and emulator-style probes - Spatial accuracy labelled SIMULATED until physical calibration

methods: Methods are the campus measurement plans in configs/campus_measurement_profiles. REPRODUCIBILITY.md says the default path is digital and that executed Pixel 6a field measurements are not in this git tree. Absolute spatial accuracy remains physical-pending in that file.
